summary: Colossal Cave Adventure entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Colossal Cave Adventure
entries.definitive_edition: Crowther/Woods text lineage for historical route; Colossal Cave (2023) as modern comparison

emulation.emulator: Terminal/mainframe or modern text port as appropriate
emulation.notes: Record exact port/version and transcript if possible.

primary.why: Colossal Cave Adventure is a foundational text adventure, and the core historical route is the original Crowther/Woods text lineage rather than the modern 3D remake. The 2023 Colossal Cave remake is valuable as a modern reimagining and accessibility route, but it should be logged separately from the text artifact.
primary.how_to_play: Use a preserved text version/port of Adventure and record version, parser/port, scoring target, map or hint use, and command transcript. Use the 2023 Colossal Cave remake only as a modern comparison route.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the modern remake.
secondary.why: It changes presentation and interface enough to be a separate route.

all_releases.platform: Crowther/Woods expanded text version and ports
all_releases.reason: primary: most influential and practical historical route.

all_releases.platform: Colossal Cave 3D remake on PC / consoles / VR
all_releases.reason: secondary: accessibility/modern comparison route, not a replacement for the text artifact.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The text version is the historical artifact; the 2023 remake is a modern interpretation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record text-version/port and scoring target; do not substitute the 3D remake for the original parser experience.
